extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance plots digitized: Figure 1a,b and Figure 3a,b. Figure 2 and Figure 3c are characterization images/plots and were skipped. Selectivity values in Figure 1a were read on the right y-axis; STY/rate values were read on the left y-axis. Stability plot Figure 3b was digitized only at first and last plotted points as requested. In Figure 1a, In2O3/ZrO2 temperature points appear only where diamond markers are visible; values are approximate from the image.
